# PooledClientExtensions

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Dataverse.Pooling.PooledClientExtensions`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Dataverse`

## Summary

Extension methods on PPDS.Dataverse.Pooling.IPooledClient for common Dataverse SDK operations that wrap Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk.OrganizationRequest/Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk.OrganizationResponse pairs into strongly-typed async helpers.

#### PublishAllXmlAsync

```text
public static System.Threading.Tasks.Task PublishAllXmlAsync(PPDS.Dataverse.Pooling.IPooledClient client, System.String environmentKey, System.Threading.CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Publishes all customizations in the environment.

- Parameter `client`: The pooled client to execute the request on.
- Parameter `environmentKey`: A stable key identifying the target environment (e.g., environment URL or org unique name). Used to scope the publish lock so different environments can publish concurrently.
- Parameter `cancellationToken`: Cancellation token.

Remarks: Wraps Microsoft.Crm.Sdk.Messages.PublishAllXmlRequest with per-environment concurrency protection. Shares the same per-environment semaphore as PPDS.Dataverse.Pooling.PooledClientExtensions.PublishXmlAsync(PPDS.Dataverse.Pooling.IPooledClient,System.String,System.String,System.Threading.CancellationToken) so that a PublishAll and a PublishXml cannot run simultaneously for the same environment. If a publish is already in progress for the environment, throws System.InvalidOperationException. Callers in the RPC/Application Service layer should catch this and wrap it in a PpdsException with an appropriate error code.

#### PublishXmlAsync

```text
public static System.Threading.Tasks.Task PublishXmlAsync(PPDS.Dataverse.Pooling.IPooledClient client, System.String parameterXml, System.String environmentKey, System.Threading.CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Publishes specific customizations using a PublishXml request.

- Parameter `client`: The pooled client to execute the request on.
- Parameter `parameterXml`: The XML describing which customizations to publish. For example: &lt;importexportxml&gt;&lt;webresources&gt;&lt;webresource&gt;&#123;id&#125;&lt;/webresource&gt;&lt;/webresources&gt;&lt;/importexportxml&gt;
- Parameter `environmentKey`: A stable key identifying the target environment (e.g., environment URL or org unique name). Used to scope the publish lock so different environments can publish concurrently.
- Parameter `cancellationToken`: Cancellation token.

Remarks: Wraps Microsoft.Crm.Sdk.Messages.PublishXmlRequest with per-environment concurrency protection. Only one publish operation (PublishXml or PublishAll) can run at a time per environment to avoid server-side conflicts and redundant API calls. If a publish is already in progress for the environment, throws System.InvalidOperationException. Callers in the RPC/Application Service layer should catch this and wrap it in a PpdsException with an appropriate error code.

#### RetrieveUnpublishedAsync

```text
public static System.Threading.Tasks.Task`1<Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk.Entity> RetrieveUnpublishedAsync(PPDS.Dataverse.Pooling.IPooledClient client, System.String entityLogicalName, System.Guid id, Microsoft.Xrm.Sdk.Query.ColumnSet columnSet, System.Threading.CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
```

Retrieves an unpublished record from Dataverse.

- Parameter `client`: The pooled client to execute the request on.
- Parameter `entityLogicalName`: The logical name of the entity to retrieve.
- Parameter `id`: The unique identifier of the record.
- Parameter `columnSet`: The columns to retrieve.
- Parameter `cancellationToken`: Cancellation token.

Returns: The unpublished entity record.

Remarks: Uses Microsoft.Crm.Sdk.Messages.RetrieveUnpublishedRequest to fetch the draft (unpublished) version of a record. This is essential for web resource editing where the user needs to see the latest saved content, not the last-published version.
